comments.author: Sharky
comments.body:
Throwing in my experience on grinding this skill:
-Choose a job that favors rowing: Brigand is the cheapest.
-Grind afk using tow permits to autonav from Cairo to Nantes
-use light galley(LG): Slowest row ship from my experience. (I also modded my LG with out-of-range cargo for all -20 penalties during each mod to really slow it down)
-remove all sail ship parts, and get ships sails damaged/ripped.
-equip iron plates -11 H sails & v sails
-equip figurehead Quetzalcoatl for +7 fatigue relief and +7 crises protection (Sculpting- Caribbean divine beast: Jamaica invest - 1.2m)
-remove all oxford ship speed skills if active
-keep at least 1m on you (i keep 5m which is plenty). Dont worry about npc attacks. They don't attack in safe waters using autonav, but i use caution anyway for the grind along with survey so i know how close i am to destination.
-keep about 50 timber on you for repairs from storms etc. Never had my ship sink from storms with r10 repair
-load the rest of your cargo with food & water evenly.
-keep maximum amount of vigor food (400+)
-set timer according to how much fatigue builds so that you can pop vigor food when fatigue is almost maxed or vigor is low. Fatigue will accumulate faster the longer you are out to sea so adjust timer accordingly.

Boosts:
-DONT USE GEAR!!! Its easy to forget to check its dura when afk sailing (havent tested this with Sword of the Sea People +2 row yet, though i dont think weapons lose dura when sailing)
-Use aide with +1 row skill. I like Io, but choose one for your needs.

-Optional boosts:
I prefer to use skill notes and either a 7 day or 30 day 50% proficiency rate acquisition. (you can also use Battle skills Instruction: +3 for all maritime skills for 24 hours but this is a really long grind, more than a month unless you don't need sleep, and that can get expensive.)

Once you refine you get permanent +2 row as well. So get back out there and max rowing again! lol

comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
It's also possible to do the following:

1. Take the Ganador transport to Command Center
2. Start a mission with Maymay the beginner newbie Ganador
3. Set sail, hit rowing, and come back in 30 minutes when the mission fails to restart the process.

This is useful as you can use any rowboat for this, since you'll never arrive at a location, the NPC ships are too weak to cause any real damage to medium/high level ships, food/water are free in Ganador docks, and all but a few disasters cannot occur at sea in Ganador missions.

The only drawback is that you need to return every 30 minutes to start the mission again, but if you're not going to be afk for hours at a time or are expecting to play with friends soon, this is a nice, relaxing way to casual row grind.
